description: This source file contains functions for managing plugin runtime dependencies in a Node.js environment. It includes utilities for reading/writing JSON, handling file paths, verifying dependency versions, staging dependencies, and installing runtime dependencies for bundled plugins.

methods.name: readJson
methods.description: Reads a JSON file synchronously and parses its content.

methods.name: writeJson
methods.description: Serializes a value as JSON and writes it to a file.

methods.name: removePathIfExists
methods.description: Removes a file or directory path if it exists.

methods.name: makeTempDir
methods.description: Creates a temporary directory with specified parent and prefix.

methods.name: sanitizeTempPrefixSegment
methods.description: Sanitizes a string to be safe as a temp directory prefix segment.

methods.name: replaceDir
methods.description: Replaces a target directory with a source directory, preserving atomicity.

methods.name: dependencyNodeModulesPath
methods.description: Constructs a path to a dependency within node_modules.

methods.name: readInstalledDependencyVersion
methods.description: Reads the installed version of a dependency from its package.json.

methods.name: dependencyVersionSatisfied
methods.description: Checks if an installed version satisfies a semantic version specifier.

methods.name: collectInstalledRuntimeClosure
methods.description: Collects all dependencies in the closure satisfying version constraints.

methods.name: listBundledPluginRuntimeDirs
methods.description: Lists directories of bundled plugins with package.json under a specific extension directory.

methods.name: hasRuntimeDeps
methods.description: Checks if a package.json has dependencies or optional dependencies.

methods.name: shouldStageRuntimeDeps
methods.description: Determines if runtime dependencies should be staged based on package.json config.

methods.name: sanitizeBundledManifestForRuntimeInstall
methods.description: Removes peerDependencies, devDependencies related to openclaw in package.json for staging.

methods.name: resolveRuntimeDepsStampPath
methods.description: Gets the path for the runtime deps stamp file for a plugin.

methods.name: createRuntimeDepsFingerprint
methods.description: Creates a SHA-256 hash as a fingerprint of package.json.

methods.name: readRuntimeDepsStamp
methods.description: Reads the runtime dependencies stamp if it exists.

methods.name: stageInstalledRootRuntimeDeps
methods.description: Stages dependencies in the root node_modules for a plugin, creating a tarred closure.

methods.name: installPluginRuntimeDeps
methods.description: Installs necessary runtime dependencies for a plugin, either via copying or npm install.

methods.name: installPluginRuntimeDepsWithRetries
methods.description: Retries installation of plugin runtime dependencies multiple times upon failure.

methods.name: stageBundledPluginRuntimeDeps
methods.description: Main exported function that stages runtime dependencies for all bundled plugins.
